							add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ratn = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_item = 61 }
					var:global.cwec_s9_target = { exists = yes } }
				var:global.cwec_s9_target = { if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_9 > 0 } }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ratm = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_9 = 3 } }
							add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s9_ratn = 1 }
						}
				} }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = global.cwec_s9_ratm }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_m min = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s9_pct = global.cwec_s9_ratn }
			multiply_variable = { global.cwec_s9_pct = 100 }
			divide_variable = { global.cwec_s9_pct = cwec_t_m }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_left = global.cwec_s10_due }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_s10_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_s10_left min = 0 }
		# progress of the phase in per cent
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_pct = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_len > 0 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_pct = global.num_days }
			subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_s10_pct = global.cwec_s10_since }
			multiply_variable = { global.cwec_s10_pct = 100 }
			divide_variable = { global.cwec_s10_pct = global.cwec_s10_len }
			clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_s10_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ratn = 0 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ratm = 0 }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 > 0 } }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ratm = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 3 } }
							add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ratn = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_item = 61 }
					var:global.cwec_s10_target = { exists = yes } }
				var:global.cwec_s10_target = { if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 > 0 } }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ratm = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rat_10 = 3 } }
							add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s10_ratn = 1 }
						}
				} }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = global.cwec_s10_ratm }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_m min = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_pct = global.cwec_s10_ratn }
			multiply_variable = { global.cwec_s10_pct = 100 }
			divide_variable = { global.cwec_s10_pct = cwec_t_m }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p1_item > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_p1_left = global.cwec_p1_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_p1_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_p1_left min = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_len = global.cwec_p1_end }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_len = global.cwec_p1_start }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_len min = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_p1_pct = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_p1_pct = global.cwec_p1_start }
		multiply_variable = { global.cwec_p1_pct = 100 }
		divide_variable = { global.cwec_p1_pct = cwec_t_len }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_p1_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p2_item > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_p2_left = global.cwec_p2_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_p2_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_p2_left min = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_len = global.cwec_p2_end }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_len = global.cwec_p2_start }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_len min = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_p2_pct = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_p2_pct = global.cwec_p2_start }
		multiply_variable = { global.cwec_p2_pct = 100 }
		divide_variable = { global.cwec_p2_pct = cwec_t_len }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_p2_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_p3_item > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_p3_left = global.cwec_p3_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_p3_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_p3_left min = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_len = global.cwec_p3_end }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_len = global.cwec_p3_start }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_len min = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_p3_pct = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_p3_pct = global.cwec_p3_start }
		multiply_variable = { global.cwec_p3_pct = 100 }
		divide_variable = { global.cwec_p3_pct = cwec_t_len }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_p3_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_left = global.cwec_h1_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_h1_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_h1_left min = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h1_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_h1_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = 0.13699 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_h1_pct = cwec_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_h1_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_left = global.cwec_h2_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_h2_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_h2_left min = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h2_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_h2_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = 0.13699 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_h2_pct = cwec_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_h2_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_left = global.cwec_h3_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_h3_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_h3_left min = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_h3_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_h3_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = 0.13699 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_h3_pct = cwec_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_h3_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_left = global.cwec_l1_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_l1_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_l1_left min = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_l1_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = 0.05495 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_l1_pct = cwec_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_l1_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_left = global.cwec_l2_end }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_l2_left = global.num_days }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_l2_left min = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_pct = 100 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = global.cwec_l2_left }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = 0.05495 }
		subtract_from_variable = { global.cwec_l2_pct = cwec_t_x }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_l2_pct min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	# political groups of the Parliament (information only): seats x party popularity of each member
	set_variable = { global.cwec_grp_COM = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_grp_SOC = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_grp_GRN = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_grp_LIB = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_grp_CD = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_grp_GAU = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_grp_CONS = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_grp_ER = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { party_pop_array^num > 23 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^4 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_COM = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^5 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_COM = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^19 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_COM = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^3 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_SOC = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^18 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_SOC = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^17 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_GRN = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^2 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_LIB = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^16 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_LIB = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^1 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_CD = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^14 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_GAU = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^6 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_CONS = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^20 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_ER = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^21 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_ER = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^0 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^7 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^8 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^9 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^10 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^11 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^12 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^13 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^15 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^22 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = party_pop_array^23 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_x = cwec_seats }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_grp_NI = cwec_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	round_variable = global.cwec_grp_COM
	round_variable = global.cwec_grp_SOC
	round_variable = global.cwec_grp_GRN
	round_variable = global.cwec_grp_LIB
	round_variable = global.cwec_grp_CD
	round_variable = global.cwec_grp_GAU
	round_variable = global.cwec_grp_CONS
	round_variable = global.cwec_grp_ER

	COLDWAR_EC_count_projects = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_count_aid = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_workload = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ui_nact = cwec_t_act }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ui_loadpct = cwec_t_load }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_ui_loadpct = -1 }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_ui_loadpct = 100 }
	round_variable = global.cwec_ui_loadpct
}

# Any scope. Live count of the vote on the floor for the window (stamps, bar, Parliament).
COLDWAR_EC_vote_preview = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_n = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_w = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_wf = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_wa = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_nv = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_nf = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_na = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_s = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_sf = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_sa = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_q = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_stamp = 0 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_epstamp = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no
					check_variable = { global.cwec_floor > 0 } }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_n = 1 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_w = cwec_weight }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_s = cwec_seats }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_vote_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue } }
					set_variable = { cwec_ui_stamp = cwec_vote }
					add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_nv = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_vote = 1 } }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_wf = cwec_weight }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_nf = 1 }
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwec_vote = 2 } }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_wa = cwec_weight }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_na = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_vital_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue } }
					set_variable = { cwec_ui_stamp = 4 }
				}
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_epstamp = cwec_ui_stamp }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_epstamp = 4 } }
					set_variable = { cwec_ui_epstamp = 2 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_epv_issue = global.cwec_floor_issue }
						check_variable = { cwec_epv > 0 } }
					set_variable = { cwec_ui_epstamp = cwec_epv }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_epstamp = 1 } }
					add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_sf = cwec_seats }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_epstamp = 2 } }
					add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_sa = cwec_seats }
				}
			}
			# legend square: 1 For, 2 Against, 3 awaiting, 4 no reading
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }  }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_legst = 4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_ep = 0 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_legst = 4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_epstamp = 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_legst = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_epstamp = 2 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_legst = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_legst = 3 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_live_q = global.cwec_live_w }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_live_q = 0.705 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_live_q = 0.499 }
	round_variable = global.cwec_live_q
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_floor_item = 120 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ui_size = global.cwec_floor_size }
		COLDWAR_EC_capacity_preview = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_code: an entry of the running list; temp cwec_t_pct: its progress.
COLDWAR_EC_ui_run_pct = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s1_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 2 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s2_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s3_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 4 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s4_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s5_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s6_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 7 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s7_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 8 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s8_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 9 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s9_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 10 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_s10_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 101 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_p1_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 102 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_p2_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 103 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_p3_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 111 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_h1_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 112 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_h2_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 113 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_h3_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 121 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_l1_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 122 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_l2_pct }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_code = 130 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = global.cwec_ui_loadpct }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_pct = 1.667 }
	}
}

# Country scope (viewer). Which view the Council card shows: the vote on the floor, a running ratification, or nothing; its cards and stamps.
COLDWAR_EC_ui_council_view = {
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_cview = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 0 }
	# year and number of the file shown
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = global.cwec_epoch }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = 365 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwec_t_y
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = 1970 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_cview = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_fyear = cwec_t_y }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_fno = global.cwec_floor_issue }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s1_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s2_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s3_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s4_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s5_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 6 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s6_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 7 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s7_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 8 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s8_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 9 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s9_by }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 10 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = global.cwec_s10_by }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fby = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 2 }
				check_variable = { cwec_ui_fstage = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 7 }
				check_variable = { cwec_ui_fstage = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 7 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 6 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 8 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 9 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 11 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 12 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 13 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_fstepf = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fthr = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_chipf = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fthr = 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_chipf = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 5 } check_variable = { cwec_ui_fproc = 6 } } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_chipf = 4 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_chipf = 2 }
		}
		# player cards and their stamps
		clear_array = cwec_ui_vall
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					add_to_array = { PREV.cwec_ui_vall = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_nv = cwec_ui_vall^num }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = cwec_ui_nv }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 3 }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 4 }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 0.499 }
		round_temp_variable = cwec_t_r
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_r min = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vpages = cwec_t_r }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vpage < cwec_ui_vpages } } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vpage = cwec_ui_vpages }
			add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_vpage = -1 }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_vpage min = 0 }
		clear_array = cwec_ui_vpg
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = cwec_ui_vpage }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = cwec_t_lo }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = 4 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = cwec_ui_vall
			value = cwec_t_val
			index = cwec_t_idx
			if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_vpg = cwec_t_val } }
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vpage1 = cwec_ui_vpage }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_vpage1 = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vpg^num > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1 = cwec_ui_vpg^0 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vpg^num > 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2 = cwec_ui_vpg^1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vpg^num > 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3 = cwec_ui_vpg^2 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vpg^num > 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4 = cwec_ui_vpg^3 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1s = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1d = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1 > 0 } }
			var:cwec_ui_vt1 = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_st = cwec_ui_stamp } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1s = cwec_t_st }
			add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1s = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2s = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2d = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2 > 0 } }
			var:cwec_ui_vt2 = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_st = cwec_ui_stamp } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2s = cwec_t_st }
			add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2s = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3s = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3d = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3 > 0 } }
			var:cwec_ui_vt3 = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_st = cwec_ui_stamp } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3s = cwec_t_st }
			add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3s = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4s = 1 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4d = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4 > 0 } }
			var:cwec_ui_vt4 = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_st = cwec_ui_stamp } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4s = cwec_t_st }
			add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4s = 1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s1_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 1 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s1_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s1_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s1_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s1_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s2_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s2_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s2_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s2_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s2_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s3_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 3 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s3_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s3_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s3_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s3_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s4_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 4 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s4_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s4_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s4_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s4_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s5_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 5 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s5_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s5_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s5_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s5_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s6_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 6 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s6_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s6_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s6_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s6_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s7_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 7 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s7_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s7_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s7_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s7_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s8_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 8 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s8_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s8_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s8_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s8_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s9_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 9 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s9_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s9_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s9_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s9_issue }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot = 10 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = global.cwec_s10_item }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rn = global.cwec_s10_ratn }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rm = global.cwec_s10_ratm }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rissue = global.cwec_s10_issue }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_rslot > 0 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_cview = 2 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 3 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 4 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 7 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 9 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 10 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 11 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 12 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 27 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 28 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 52 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 61 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 7 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ritem = 87 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 2 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_ryear = cwec_t_y }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rno = cwec_ui_rissue }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_rproc = 7 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rstepf = 6 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_rstepf = 4 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rpend = cwec_ui_rm }
			subtract_from_variable = { cwec_ui_rpend = cwec_ui_rn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = cwec_ui_rm }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_m min = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_p = cwec_ui_rn }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_p = 100 }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_p = cwec_t_m }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_rbarf = cwec_t_p }
			divide_variable = { cwec_ui_rbarf = 5 }
			round_variable = cwec_ui_rbarf
			add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_rbarf = 1 }

				array = cwec_ui_vall
				value = cwec_t_val
				index = cwec_t_idx
				if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_vpg = cwec_t_val } }
			}
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vpage1 = cwec_ui_vpage }
			add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_vpage1 = 1 }

			}

			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vpg^num > 2 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3 = cwec_ui_vpg^2 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4 = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vpg^num > 3 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4 = cwec_ui_vpg^3 }
			}
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1s = 6 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1d = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1 > 0 } }
				var:cwec_ui_vt1 = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_st = cwec_ui_rst } set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_dd = cwec_ui_rdays } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1s = cwec_t_st }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt1d = cwec_t_dd }
			}
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2s = 6 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2d = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2 > 0 } }
				var:cwec_ui_vt2 = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_st = cwec_ui_rst } set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_dd = cwec_ui_rdays } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2s = cwec_t_st }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt2d = cwec_t_dd }
			}
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3s = 6 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3d = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3 > 0 } }
				var:cwec_ui_vt3 = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_st = cwec_ui_rst } set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_dd = cwec_ui_rdays } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3s = cwec_t_st }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt3d = cwec_t_dd }
			}
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4s = 6 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4d = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4 > 0 } }
				var:cwec_ui_vt4 = { set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_st = cwec_ui_rst } set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_dd = cwec_ui_rdays } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4s = cwec_t_st }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_vt4d = cwec_t_dd }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Viewer scope. Rows of the paged lists (an entry of a dynamic list cannot show variables of its element).
COLDWAR_EC_ui_rows = {
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_s_m1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_rows^num > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_s_m1 = cwec_ui_rows^0 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_s_m2 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_rows^num > 1 } }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_s_m2 = cwec_ui_rows^1 }
	}
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_s_m3 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_rows^num > 2 } }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_s_m3 = cwec_ui_rows^2 }
	}

	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_tot = 0 }

	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_tot = global.cwec_grp_SOC }

	round_variable = cwec_ui_bf_agri
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_agri = 1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_bf_agri min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = 21 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = cwec_t_used }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_agri > cwec_t_room } } set_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_agri = cwec_t_room } }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_agri = cwec_t_used }
	multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_agri = 16 }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_agri = 700 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_used = cwec_ui_bf_agri }

	round_variable = cwec_ui_bf_reg
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_reg = 1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_bf_reg min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = 21 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = cwec_t_used }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_reg > cwec_t_room } } set_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_reg = cwec_t_room } }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_reg = cwec_t_used }
	multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_reg = 16 }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_reg = 700 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_used = cwec_ui_bf_reg }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_used = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_p = global.cwec_sh_res }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_res = cwec_t_p }
	divide_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_res = 5 }
	round_variable = cwec_ui_bf_res
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_res = 1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_bf_res min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = 21 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = cwec_t_used }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_res > cwec_t_room } } set_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_res = cwec_t_room } }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_res = cwec_t_used }
	multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_res = 16 }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_res = 700 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_used = cwec_ui_bf_res }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_used = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_p = global.cwec_sh_adm }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_adm = cwec_t_p }
	divide_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_adm = 5 }
	round_variable = cwec_ui_bf_adm
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_adm = 1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_bf_adm min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = 21 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = cwec_t_used }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_adm > cwec_t_room } } set_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_adm = cwec_t_room } }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_adm = cwec_t_used }
	multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_adm = 16 }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_adm = 700 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_used = cwec_ui_bf_adm }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_used = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_p = global.cwec_sh_oth }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_oth = cwec_t_p }
	divide_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_oth = 5 }
	round_variable = cwec_ui_bf_oth
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_oth = 1 }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_bf_oth min = 1 max = 21 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = 21 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_room = cwec_t_used }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_oth > cwec_t_room } } set_variable = { cwec_ui_bf_oth = cwec_t_room } }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_oth = cwec_t_used }
	multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_oth = 16 }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_bx_oth = 700 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_used = cwec_ui_bf_oth }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_used = -1 }
	# members and partners table
	clear_array = cwec_ui_rows_all
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwec_ui_rows_all = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_watch
		if = { limit = { exists = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } check_variable = { cwec_status > 0 } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwec_ui_rows_all = THIS } }
	}
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_nrows = cwec_ui_rows_all^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = cwec_ui_nrows }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 13 }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 14 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwec_t_r
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_r min = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_mpages = cwec_t_r }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_mpage < cwec_ui_mpages } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_mpage = cwec_ui_mpages }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_mpage = -1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_mpage min = 0 }
	clear_array = cwec_ui_rows
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = cwec_ui_mpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = 14 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = cwec_t_lo }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = 14 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cwec_ui_rows_all
		value = cwec_t_val
		index = cwec_t_idx
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_rows = cwec_t_val } }
	}
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_mpage1 = cwec_ui_mpage }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_mpage1 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_tab = 4 }
			check_variable = { cwec_ui_recip > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_EC_ui_aid_preview = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_ui_rows = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_ui_values = yes
}

# Any scope. Something changed: refresh the open windows only.
COLDWAR_EC_touch = {
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_dirty = 1 }
	COLDWAR_EC_ui_global = yes
	clear_temp_array = cwec_t_closed
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_viewers
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes
				is_ai = no
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open }
			COLDWAR_EC_ui_refresh = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_array = { cwec_t_closed = THIS }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwec_t_closed
		remove_from_array = { global.cwec_viewers = THIS }
	}
}

# Country scope (viewer). Countries that can be chosen for the selected proposal; read only when a proposal is selected.
COLDWAR_EC_ui_build_targets = {
	clear_array = cwec_ui_targets_all
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_sel = 61 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_watch
			if = { limit = { exists = yes OR = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 2 } check_variable = { cwec_status = 3 } } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwec_ui_targets_all = THIS } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_sel = 62 } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = MLT MLT = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = MLT } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CYP CYP = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = CYP } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = TUR TUR = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = TUR } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = GRE GRE = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = GRE } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SPR SPR = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = SPR } }

		if = { limit = { country_exists = TUN TUN = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = TUN } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ALG ALG = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = ALG } }

		if = { limit = { country_exists = SWI SWI = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = SWI } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = FIN FIN = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = FIN } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ICE ICE = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = ICE } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = NRY NRY = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = NRY } }

		if = { limit = { country_exists = SER SER = { check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = SER } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_assoc_req
			if = { limit = { exists = yes check_variable = { cwec_status = 0 } NOT = { is_in_array = { array = PREV.cwec_ui_targets_all value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { PREV.cwec_ui_targets_all = THIS } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_sel = 86 } }

		if = { limit = { country_exists = ARG ARG = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = ARG } }

		if = { limit = { country_exists = POL POL = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = POL } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = CZE CZE = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = CZE } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = DDR DDR = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = DDR } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = HUN HUN = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = HUN } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SER SER = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = SER } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = PAK PAK = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = PAK } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = IND IND = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = IND } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = NIG NIG = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = NIG } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = AGL AGL = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = AGL } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = MOZ MOZ = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = MOZ } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ZIM ZIM = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = ZIM } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ETH ETH = { NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets_all = ETH } }
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes } NOT = { is_in_array = { array = PREV.cwec_ui_targets_all value = THIS } } }
			add_to_array = { PREV.cwec_ui_targets_all = THIS }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_ntargets = cwec_ui_targets_all^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = cwec_ui_ntargets }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 15 }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 16 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwec_t_r
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_r min = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_tpages = cwec_t_r }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_tpage < cwec_ui_tpages } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_tpage = cwec_ui_tpages }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_tpage = -1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_tpage min = 0 }
	clear_array = cwec_ui_targets
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = cwec_ui_tpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = 16 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = cwec_t_lo }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = 16 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cwec_ui_targets_all
		value = cwec_t_val
		index = cwec_t_idx
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_targets = cwec_t_val } }
	}
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_tpage1 = cwec_ui_tpage }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_tpage1 = 1 }
}

# Country scope (viewer). Player countries outside the Communities (absent players of the last year included), by continent. Runs only when the player opens the tab, filters or turns the page.
COLDWAR_EC_ui_build_recipients = {
	clear_array = cwec_ui_recips_all
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cont = cwec_ui_cont }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			exists = yes
			NOT = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes }
			OR = { is_ai = no has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen }
			OR = { check_variable = { cwec_t_cont = 0 } AND = { check_variable = { cwec_t_cont = 1 } is_in_europe = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwec_t_cont = 2 } is_in_the_middle_east = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwec_t_cont = 3 } is_in_asia = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwec_t_cont = 4 } is_in_africa = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwec_t_cont = 5 } is_in_the_americas = yes } AND = { check_variable = { cwec_t_cont = 6 } is_in_oceania = yes } }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } }
		add_to_array = { PREV.cwec_ui_recips_all = THIS }
	}
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_nrecips = cwec_ui_recips_all^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = cwec_ui_nrecips }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 3 }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 4 }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_r = 0.499 }
	round_temp_variable = cwec_t_r
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_r min = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_rpages = cwec_t_r }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_rpage < cwec_ui_rpages } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_rpage = cwec_ui_rpages }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_rpage = -1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_rpage min = 0 }
	clear_array = cwec_ui_recips
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = cwec_ui_rpage }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = 4 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = cwec_t_lo }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = 4 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = cwec_ui_recips_all
		value = cwec_t_val
		index = cwec_t_idx
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_lo } } check_variable = { cwec_t_idx < cwec_t_hi } } add_to_array = { cwec_ui_recips = cwec_t_val } }
	}
	set_variable = { cwec_ui_rpage1 = cwec_ui_rpage }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_ui_rpage1 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_recip > 0 }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cwec_ui_recips_all value = cwec_ui_recip } } }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_recip = 0 }
	}
}

# Country scope (viewer). Live preview of an assistance programme from the real values of the recipient (11.2) and the capacity of every player member (11.3).
COLDWAR_EC_ui_aid_preview = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_recip > 0 }
			var:cwec_ui_recip = { exists = yes } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_S = cwec_ui_size }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_S = 0.5 }
		var:cwec_ui_recip = {
			COLDWAR_EC_calc_eff = yes
			COLDWAR_EC_reform_gap = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@oil }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@oil }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@steel }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@steel }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 2 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@aluminium }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@aluminium }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 3 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@chromium }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@chromium }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 4 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@tungsten }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@tungsten }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 5 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_produced@rubber }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_s = resource_consumed@rubber }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_s > cwec_t_V } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_V = cwec_t_s }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_res = 6 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_gdp = gdp_total }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_unemp = total_unemployed_percentage_display }
			multiply_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_unemp = 100 }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_V = cwec_t_V }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_res = cwec_t_res }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_gap = cwec_t_gap }
			set_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_eff = cwec_t_eff }
			if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_1_dynamic_modifier } }
				set_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_dev = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_3_dynamic_modifier } }
				set_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_dev = 3 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_r_dev = 2 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_glob = globalism_value }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_al = mdcw_cw_alignment }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { PREV.cwec_ui_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = cwec_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment > 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_c = 1.5 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_SE = cwec_t_S }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_SE = cwec_t_eff }
		# what the recipient gets (per cent or flat, after size and E)
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_type = 1 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g1 = 8 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_type = 2 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g1 = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_type = 3 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g1 = 0.03 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_type = 4 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g1 = 10 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g2 = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_type = 5 } }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g1 = 5 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g2 = 3 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g1 = 8 }
		}
		multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g1 = cwec_t_SE }
		multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_g2 = cwec_t_SE }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_type = 6 } }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_pv_g1 max = 12 }
		}
		# return values
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_x1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_f = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ret = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_M = cwec_ui_r_gdp }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_M = 50 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_M min = 0.2 max = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_f = cwec_t_M }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 50 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = cwec_t_glob }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 100 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_O = 1 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_O min = 0.5 max = 1.5 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = 1.5 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = cwec_t_M }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = cwec_t_S }
			clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_pv_m1 max = 3 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m2 = 0.5 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m2 = cwec_t_M }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m2 = cwec_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = 5 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = cwec_t_O }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = cwec_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = cwec_t_O }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = cwec_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_x1 = 3 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_x1 = cwec_t_S }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ret = 2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_R = cwec_ui_r_V }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_R = 20 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_R min = 0.25 max = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_f = cwec_t_R }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_RS = cwec_t_R }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_RS = cwec_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_r_res = 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = 4 }
				multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = cwec_t_RS }
				clamp_variable = { var = cwec_ui_pv_m1 max = 10 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_r_res = 6 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = 0.5 }
				multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = cwec_t_RS }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = cwec_t_RS }
			}
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = 8 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = cwec_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = cwec_t_RS }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ret = 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_U = cwec_ui_r_unemp }
			divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_U = 8 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_U min = 0.25 max = 2 }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_f = cwec_t_U }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_US = cwec_t_U }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_US = cwec_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = 0.5 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = cwec_t_US }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_x1 = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_x1 = cwec_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = 5 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = cwec_t_US }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = 0.1 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = cwec_t_US }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ret = 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_GS = cwec_ui_r_gap }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_GS = cwec_t_S }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = cwec_t_GS }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = 0.02 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d1 = cwec_t_GS }
			set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = 2 }
			multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_d2 = cwec_t_GS }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_ui_ret = 5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_al = 0 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_x1 = 25 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_al > 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_x1 = 15 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_al > 1 } }
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = 15 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_m1 = 5 }
			}
		}
		# cost and capacity
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_cost = cwec_t_c }
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_share = cwec_t_c }
		multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_share = 230.77 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gs = gdp_total }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_gs = global.cwec_bg_gdp }
		multiply_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_share = cwec_t_gs }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_add = cwec_ui_size }
		COLDWAR_EC_size_to_malus = yes
		set_variable = { cwec_ui_pv_capk = cwec_t_addm }
		COLDWAR_EC_capacity_preview_build = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_addm: capacity of every player member now and with one more programme (cwec_pb_*).
COLDWAR_EC_capacity_preview_build = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_m = cwec_t_addm }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_m max = 3 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { cwec_pb_now = mdcw_cw_cap_max }
				set_variable = { cwec_pb_used = mdcw_cw_cap_used }
				set_variable = { cwec_pb_after = mdcw_cw_cap_max }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwec_pb_after = cwec_aidcap }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwec_pb_after = cwec_t_m }
				set_variable = { cwec_pb_newt = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwec_pb_newp = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwec_pb_used > cwec_pb_after }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
					COLDWAR_EC_find_newest = yes
					set_variable = { cwec_pb_newt = cwec_t_bestn }
					set_variable = { cwec_pb_newp = cwec_t_bestc }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
